latestVersion.changelog:
Viral Short-Form Video Factory 1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI-powered workflow to generate 30 ready-to-post TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts for any niche.
- Fully automates trend research, reverse engineering viral videos, scriptwriting, AI voiceover/video production, and export.
- Integrates Apify, InVideo AI, and Claude AI for content scraping, analysis, and production.
- Outputs include viral formats and hook analysis, scripts, captions, hashtags, platform-optimized videos, and a posting calendar.
- Accepts clear input structure for niche, audience, style, platforms, and production details.
